question: Across a bounded assumed joint design envelope, what paired fixed-reference-area CL and rigidized point-mass descent range changes arise among rigid, one-way frozen-load, and static feedback arms, and between frozen-rigid and updated-deformed structural pressure distributions?
evidence_kind: deterministic computed scenario envelope; not a probability distribution, fish calibration, or empirical validation
model_chain: existing Euler-Bernoulli FEM response in engineering.fin_mechanics.beam via engineering.aeroelastic.model
existing RK4 point-mass glide in engineering.simulation.glide; final elastic shape rigidized

scenario_axes.EI_scale: multiplies all equivalent-fin EI values; dimensionless assumed design perturbation
scenario_axes.aerodynamic_load_scale: uniformly scales VLM force vectors after pressure solve; also scales reported fixed-area CL; dimensionless assumed pressure/load perturbation
scenario_axes.mass_scale: multiplies assumed point-mass flight mass; dimensionless
scenario_axes.CD0_scale: multiplies assumed parasite drag coefficient CD0; dimensionless

correlation_scope: Three paired stress-envelope rows encode co-varying assumptions; they do not define marginals, a joint probability law, confidence intervals, or population variation.

pressure_policies.frozen-rigid-distribution: Use the undeformed rigid-geometry VLM panel-force distribution for structural load transfer at every iteration; transfer it onto the current structural lattice. This is an explicit frozen-pressure alternative.
pressure_policies.updated-deformed-distribution: Recompute VLM panel forces on the current deformed geometry at each existing solver iteration; this is the existing feedback policy.

paired_estimands: signed delta_CL = arm CL - same-scenario, same-pressure-policy, same-mesh rigid CL
signed delta_range_m = arm main-dt descent range - paired rigid main-dt descent range
main-vs-fine discrepancy of the paired delta_CL and delta_range_m; descriptive mesh-resolution estimate, not a validated error bound
existing feedback residual/iteration history and main-vs-half-dt range discrepancy; descriptive fixed-point/time-resolution estimates, not independent biological validation
resolution_warning: Do not treat force/moment/virtual-work identities as independent validation. Do not use the existing 3% absolute-CL mesh threshold to validate tiny paired effects. Fixed-point stopping tolerance and mesh/time discrepancies are reported as resolution diagnostics only.
unmodeled_or_unknown: measured fish fin EI, aerodynamic pressure/polar coefficients, mass, drag, or calibration
bioelectric, genetic, or cellular mapping into any mechanical parameter
failure_policy: Preserve every failed, partial, unconverged, invalid-domain, and missing scenario-arm-policy-mesh row. Do not replace or interpolate failed outputs, relax gates, or promote domain exits as valid estimates.
output_contract: results.json, per-arm existing solver result/state/flight artifacts, receipt.json, and output-ports.json. All hashes recorded. Output ports are computed scenario contrasts, not measurements.
